info.title: Mediflow API: planned endpoints
info.description: Endpoints the web app is built against that the API does not implement yet. Hand-written. When the API implements one, delete it here: the generated spec then provides it.

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's password. Asks for the current password. Every other session of the user is ended; the one making the call stays signed in.

get.description: The signed-in user's own active sessions, newest first. A user has few, so there is one page.

delete.description: Ends one of the signed-in user's other sessions: that browser is signed out on its next request. The session making the call cannot be ended here (use sign-out).

post.description: Opens a deep link to a record by its globally unique id. The server finds the hospital that owns the record, checks that the user is an active member of it, and rebinds the session to that hospital if another one (or none) is active. Every refusal is the same 403 link_unavailable, whether the record does not exist or belongs to a hospital the user does not work at, so a link cannot be used to find out what exists.

kind.description: The kind of record, e.g. notice.

200.description: The session, bound to the hospital that owns the record

get.description: Staff notices of the active tenant, newest first. Sample feature (F-13). Requires notice:read and the notices feature flag.

post.description: Archives a notice so it no longer appears in the list. Requires notice:manage.

get.description: The services the active tenant can charge for, by name, each with the price in force on its standard price list today, where today is the date at the hospital in its own timezone. Requires service:read and the services feature flag. `q` matches the code or the name. Archived services are listed only when asked for.

post.description: Adds a service. Requires service:manage. The hospital is the session's: the body carries no tenant. The code is the service's identity on bills and cannot be changed later; one already used by a service of the hospital, archived or not, is refused with 409 service_code_taken. `priceMinor`, when given, is its price on the standard list from today.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A repeat with the same key and request returns the first answer.

get.description: One service. Requires service:read. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

patch.description: Changes a service: its name, category, tax class or description, never its code. Requires service:manage. Send the version the change was made from: 409 conflict when the service has changed since. A price is not changed here: see the prices of a service. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

post.description: Archives a service: it stays on the charges and bills that name it and is no longer offered for new ones. Requires service:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.
Brings an archived service back. Requires service:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

get.description: The prices of a service on a price list, newest first: the one in force, those before it and any that is scheduled. Requires service:read. Without `priceListId` the hospital's standard list. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist. A `priceListId` must be a price list of the session's own hospital: any other, known elsewhere or not, answers 404 price_list_not_found. Store the reference together with the hospital (a composite key), since foreign keys are checked without row-level security.

post.description: Gives a service a new price from a date. Requires service:manage. Prices are never edited, and a charge already posted keeps the price, the tax class and the category it was posted with. The first price of a service may start today at the hospital (its timezone) or later. Once a price is in force, a new one starts tomorrow or later, never today: charges posted this morning used the price that was in force. The price in force then ends the day before the new one starts. At most one price is scheduled at a time: while one is, a second is refused with 409 price_date_conflict until it is withdrawn. An archived service takes no new price (409 service_archived). Two requests at once must not leave overlapping periods: lock the service and keep an exclusion constraint on (hospital, service, list, period). A `priceListId` must be a price list of the session's own hospital: any other, known elsewhere or not, answers 404 price_list_not_found. Store the reference together with the hospital (a composite key), since foreign keys are checked without row-level security. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A repeat with the same key and request returns the first answer.

delete.description: Withdraws a price that has not come into force yet: the price before it stays in force with no end date. Requires service:manage. A price that is or was in force cannot be withdrawn (409 price_in_force): it is history. A price that is not of this service or hospital answers 404 price_not_found. A service of another hospital answers 404 service_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

get.description: The price lists of the active tenant. Requires service:read. Every hospital has one standard list; others (for a payer or a room class) come later.

The medicines and consumables of the active tenant, by generic name then brand. Requires drug:read and the drugs feature flag. `q` matches the generic name or the brand, each word in any order. A catalog can hold tens of thousands of items: there is no unpaged form, and `total` comes with the first page only.

post.description: Adds an item. Requires drug:manage. The hospital is the session's: the body carries no tenant. An item with the same generic name, brand, form and strength as one the hospital has, archived or not, whatever the capitals, is refused with 409 drug_exists. Items that are only similar are the caller's to judge: see the duplicate check. An optional field (brand, strength, unit) is left out when there is none. Audited.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A repeat with the same key and request returns the first answer.

post.description: Finds items of the hospital, archived or not, that may be the one about to be added: the same generic name in the same form, whatever the brand or the strength. Requires drug:manage. At most ten, the closest first.

get.description: One item. Requires drug:read. An item of another hospital answers 404 drug_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

patch.description: Changes an item. Requires drug:manage. Send the version the change was made from: 409 conflict when the item has changed since, 409 drug_exists when the change would make it the same as another. Empty text removes a brand, a strength or a unit, and a null reorder level removes the level. Every change is audited with who made it and which fields changed, and a change of `schedule` or `controlled` in particular: taking an item out of a controlled schedule must leave a trace. Records that name an item keep what it was: a dispense, a stock entry and a prescription line store the generic name, brand, form, strength, schedule and controlled flag as they were when the line was written, so renaming or reclassifying an item never changes history. An item of another hospital answers 404 drug_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

post.description: Archives an item: it stays on the stock, prescriptions and bills that name it and is no longer offered for new ones. Requires drug:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. An item of another hospital answers 404 drug_not_found, the same as one that does not exist. Audited.
Brings an archived item back. Requires drug:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. An item of another hospital answers 404 drug_not_found, the same as one that does not exist. Audited.

get.description: The tests and panels the laboratory of the active tenant offers, by name. Requires labTest:read and the lab_tests feature flag. `q` matches the code or the name. `total` comes with the first page only.

post.description: Adds a test or a panel. Requires labTest:manage. The hospital is the session's: the body carries no tenant. The code is the test's identity on orders and reports and cannot be changed later; one already used by a test of the hospital, archived or not, is refused with 409 lab_test_code_taken. A `serviceId` must be a laboratory service of the same hospital, and every component of a panel a single test of the same hospital, not archived; a panel has at least one component, none twice, and a single test has none (400 otherwise): check each against the session's hospital, never by the id alone. Audited.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A repeat with the same key and request returns the first answer.

get.description: One test or panel, a panel with its components. Requires labTest:read. A test of another hospital answers 404 lab_test_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

patch.description: Changes a test: never its code, and never its kind (a test with results cannot become a panel). Requires labTest:manage. Send the version the change was made from: 409 conflict when the test has changed since. The same rules as on adding hold for `serviceId` and `componentIds`. A test that has reference ranges cannot become a text test until they are removed (409 lab_test_has_ranges). A result already reported keeps the name, unit and reference range it was reported with. Audited. A test of another hospital answers 404 lab_test_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

post.description: Archives a test: it stays on the orders and reports that name it and is no longer offered for new ones. A test that is a component of a panel that is not archived is refused with 409 lab_test_in_panel: take it out of the panel first. Requires labTest:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. Audited. A test of another hospital answers 404 lab_test_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.
Brings an archived test back. Requires labTest:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. Audited. A test of another hospital answers 404 lab_test_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

get.description: The reference ranges of a numeric test, by sex and age, with their own version. Requires labTest:read. A test of another hospital answers 404 lab_test_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

put.description: Replaces the reference ranges of a test. Requires labTest:manage. Only a numeric single test has ranges (409 lab_test_has_no_ranges for a panel or a text test). Each row gives at least one limit, `low` below `high`, a critical limit never inside the normal range, and an `ageUntil` that is later than `ageFrom` for every date of birth. Two rows for the same sex must never both hold for a patient: one has to end at or before the age the other starts from, for every date of birth. Years and months compare exactly with each other, and weeks and days with each other; a limit in months or years against one in weeks or days is accepted only when no date of birth can bring them together (a month is 28 to 31 days), so ranges that meet give the age in the same unit. A row for one sex and a row for any may share ages, and the one for the sex is used. 400 otherwise. 409 conflict when the ranges have changed since the version sent. A result already reported keeps the range it was reported against. Audited. A test of another hospital answers 404 lab_test_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

get.description: The reference range that applies to a patient of an age and a sex: the row for that sex covering that age, else the row for any sex covering it, else none. A patient whose sex is recorded as other gets only a row for any. Requires labTest:read. It answers the check on the catalog screen with an age someone typed, and identifies no patient: the age is tried as that of a person born on 1 January 2001, so 30 days is under one month. It is not how a result is read for a real patient: the laboratory works that out on the server from the date of birth of the patient of the order and the date the sample was collected, with the same rule (a limit is reached on the calendar day that lies that long after the birth; a month or a year lands on the same day of the month, or on the last day of a shorter month), and the age or date of birth of a patient is never sent in an address. A test of another hospital answers 404 lab_test_not_found, the same as one that does not exist.

parameters.name: ageValue
parameters.description: The age, in the unit given. At most 150 years.

200.description: The range that applies, if any

get.description: The bed categories of the active tenant, by name: the classes of bed it has, each charged as a bed-day service of the price catalog. Requires ward:read and the wards feature flag. `total` comes with the first page only.

post.description: Adds a bed category. Requires ward:manage. The hospital is the session's. A name already used by a category of the hospital, archived or not, whatever the capitals, is refused with 409 bed_category_name_taken. A `serviceId` must be a service of the same hospital in the bed category of the price catalog (400 otherwise): check it against the session's hospital, never by the id alone. Audited.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A repeat with the same key and request returns the first answer.

patch.description: Changes a bed category. Requires ward:manage. 409 conflict when it has changed since the version sent. The same rules as on adding hold. Empty text for `serviceId` removes the link. Audited. A category of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

post.description: Archives a bed category: it is no longer offered for a bed. Refused with 409 bed_category_in_use while a bed that is not archived has it. Requires ward:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. Audited. A category of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.
Brings an archived bed category back. Requires ward:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. Audited. A category of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

get.description: The wards of the active tenant, by name, each with how many rooms and beds it has (archived ones not counted). Requires ward:read and the wards feature flag. `q` matches the code or the name. `total` comes with the first page only.

post.description: Adds a ward, with no rooms yet. Requires ward:manage. The hospital is the session's. The code cannot be changed later; one already used by a ward of the hospital, archived or not, is refused with 409 ward_code_taken. A `departmentId` must be a department of the same hospital that is not archived (400 otherwise). Audited.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A repeat with the same key and request returns the first answer.

get.description: One ward with its rooms and their beds, archived ones included. Requires ward:read. A bed carries its status, and holds nothing about a patient. A ward of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

patch.description: Changes a ward: never its code. Requires ward:manage. 409 conflict when the ward has changed since the version sent. Empty text removes the floor or the department. Audited. A ward of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

post.description: Archives a ward: it and its beds are no longer offered for an admission. Refused with 409 ward_has_occupied_beds while a bed of it is occupied. Requires ward:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. Audited. A ward of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.
Brings an archived ward back. Requires ward:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. Audited. A ward of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

Adds a room to a ward. Requires ward:manage. Every bed is in a room: an open ward is one room with many beds. A name another room of the ward has, archived or not, is refused with 409 room_name_taken. Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A ward of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A repeat with the same key and request returns the first answer.

201.description: The ward with the new room

patch.description: Renames a room. Requires ward:manage. 409 conflict when the room has changed since the version sent. Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A room is looked up inside the ward named, and the ward at the session hospital. A ward or a room of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

post.description: Archives a room and with it the beds in it. Refused with 409 room_has_occupied_beds while a bed of it is occupied. Requires ward:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A ward or a room of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

Brings an archived room back. Its beds stay archived until each is restored. Requires ward:manage. Doing it twice changes nothing. Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A ward or a room of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

Adds a bed to a room, available. Requires ward:manage. A number another bed of the ward has, archived or not, is refused with 409 bed_number_taken. The category must be a bed category of the same hospital that is not archived, and the room not archived (400 otherwise). Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A ward or a room of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A repeat with the same key and request returns the first answer.

201.description: The ward with the new bed

patch.description: Changes the number or the category of a bed: never its status, which only the actions below and the admissions and housekeeping modules change. Requires ward:manage. 409 conflict when the bed has changed since the version sent. Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A ward or a bed of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

post.description: Takes an available bed out of use, with the reason (repair, isolation). Only an available bed can be blocked: 409 bed_not_available otherwise. Requires ward:manage. The transition is checked on the server, on the row, so two people cannot both make it. Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A ward or a bed of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

Puts a blocked bed back in use, available. 409 bed_not_blocked when it is not blocked. Requires ward:manage. The transition is checked on the server, on the row, so two people cannot both make it. Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A ward or a bed of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

Archives a bed: it is no longer offered for an admission. Refused with 409 bed_occupied while it is occupied. Requires ward:manage. The transition is checked on the server, on the row, so two people cannot both make it. Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A ward or a bed of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

Brings an archived bed back, available. Its room has to be in use (409 room_archived) and its category too (409 bed_category_archived). Requires ward:manage. The transition is checked on the server, on the row, so two people cannot both make it. Nothing of an archived ward is changed (409 ward_archived): restore the ward first. Audited. A ward or a bed of another hospital answers 404, the same as one that does not exist.

Service.description: Something the hospital can charge for. Holds no patient data. Its name, category and tax class can be changed, and a charge keeps what they were when it was posted: changing them never changes an old bill.

code.description: The service's identity on bills. Never changes.

taxClass.description: Which tax rate applies, as a class. The rate of each class is the hospital's tax setting, so a change of rate does not touch the services.

version.description: Counts the changes. Sent back as expectedVersion.

currentPrice.description: The price in force today on the standard list. Absent when there is none.

Drug.description: A medicine or a consumable the hospital keeps. What the item is, not what it costs or how much is in stock: those belong to the pharmacy and its batches. Holds no patient data.

genericName.description: The generic name of a medicine, or what a consumable is.

strength.description: As written on the pack: "500 mg".

unit.description: What one unit of stock is: "strip of 10", "100 ml bottle", "piece".

controlled.description: Whether it is handled as a controlled drug. Always true for schedule x and narcotic, whatever is sent.

reorderLevel.description: Stock at or below this many units is low. Absent: no level set.

LabTest.description: A test or a panel the laboratory offers: what it is, how it is collected and how its result is read. Holds no patient data.

code.description: The test's identity on orders and reports. Never changes.

kind.description: A single test, or a panel: a named set of tests ordered together (a lipid profile). A panel has components and no result of its own.

resultType.description: How a result is recorded: a number against a reference range, or text (positive, negative, a description). For a panel it means nothing.

unit.description: The unit of a numeric result: g/dL.

container.description: What the sample is collected in.

turnaroundHours.description: How long a result usually takes from collection.

serviceId.description: The service the test is charged as: a laboratory service of the same hospital's catalog. Empty text removes the link on a change.

serviceName.description: The name of the linked service, when there is one. The name alone is shown to everyone who may read the test, by decision; nothing else of the service (a price, a tax class) is ever added here.

components.description: The tests of a panel. Empty for a single test.

version.description: Counts the changes. Sent back as expectedVersion.

LabRange.description: What is normal for one sex in one span of age.

sex.description: Whom the row is for. A row for one sex is used before a row for any.

ageFrom.description: From this age, included: from the day the patient reaches it.

ageUntil.description: Until this age, not included: the day the patient reaches it belongs to the next range. Absent: no upper age.

low.description: The lowest normal value. Absent: no lower limit.

high.description: The highest normal value. Absent: no upper limit.

criticalLow.description: At or below this the result is critical. Never above `low`.

criticalHigh.description: At or above this the result is critical. Never below `high`.

range.description: Absent when no row covers that age and sex.

LabAge.description: An age as it is written: a value with its unit. Never turned into a count of days: a patient reaches it on the calendar day that lies that long after the date of birth, so leap years and the lengths of months are respected. At most 150 years, in any unit.

BedCategory.description: A class of bed (general ward, private room, intensive care), which decides what a day in it is charged as. The charge itself is posted by the admissions module from the linked service, at the price in force that day.

serviceId.description: The bed-day service a day in a bed of this category is charged as: a service of the same hospital's catalog in its bed category.

serviceName.description: The name of the linked service, when there is one. The name alone is shown to everyone who may read wards, by decision; nothing else of the service (a price, a tax class) is ever added here.

bedCount.description: The beds in use that have this category.

version.description: Counts the changes. Sent back as expectedVersion.
